status: MP17 PROTOTYPE - whole manipulator v1: existing modules (J2 / J3 = MP16 j23-drive-v1 · J5 = MP10 j5-wrist-v1 · wrist-type reducer = MP6 cycloid-27-v1 · gripper KG1 = MP8 at the MP9 tool-flange pose) joined by new printed links. Purchased-part sizes are listing / nominal values - measure on arrival and recalibrate (MP16 user words carried: 「오기전에 모델링은 끝내놔 치수보정은 나중에 한다고해도」)
frame: world = robot base frame at q = 0 (all link frames parallel to world): z up, desk z 0, J1 axis = z through x = y = 0. Joint origins at q = 0 (v1 + kinematics_override): J1 (0,0,96) · J2 (0,0,174) · J3 (165,0,174) · J4 (330,0,174) · J5 (408,0,174) · J6 (548,0,174). Axes: J1 z · J2 y · J3 y · J4 x · J5 y · J6 x. Part STLs are saved in their own local frames (see layout.py frames)

kinematics_override.decision: user 2026-11-06 question window 「165 로 늘림 (권장)」 after 「j2,j3가 j4 닿는거 너무 이상한거아니야/」 · 「디자인요소도 생각해야지」 — at 140 the J4 can rear cover sat 6 mm inside the J3 module circle (r 59) in the side view
kinematics_override.note: only J3 -> J4 changes (+25 along the forearm); v1 files are not edited - Codex URDF must take the same change (HANDOFF)

wrist.note: J4 / J6 MP6 output face = joint origin + 18 along the axis (MP10 neck face = J4 + 18); motor face = output face - 43.5 (MP6 stack)

colors.source: docs/brand/README.md (KMJH) · MP7 v3 exterior roles body / accent / frame / highlight

cap.note: navy end cap over the six link screws (v3 end-cap look) - J2: flat disc in a 1.5 recess of the upper arm (0.05 clearance) · J3: on the flat forearm face (that face is on the print bed, a recess there was a 72 mm ceiling) · glue / thin double-sided tape · printed inner face down so the raised mint slash (0.6) is the top layers (AMS height-range colour)

logo.note: KMJH letters (MP7 kmjh_logo.py read-only): raised 0.6 on the upper-arm box +y face (navy by AMS height range) + engraved 0.6 on the plate -y face (the forearm passes 1 mm below it)

motor_cover.corner_note: outer 45 deg corner 3 with wall 3 leaves 2.1 at the corner (6 with 2.5 cut the walls apart - trial 2026-11-06)
motor_cover.note: white U cover (open toward the drum and at both ends - driver back and connectors exposed, air flows) held by ribs on the motor body (0.15 interference); J2 cover ends at z_m 67 below the shoulder plate layer (y 43); print PETG / ASA if the motor runs hot (PLA softens near 55 C)

base_ring.note: mint snap ring in a groove of the BASE wall (v3 base ring) - groove top 45 deg (a flat 1.4 ledge made Bambu ask for support, printprep 2026-11-06) · ring inner top corner 45 deg to match

sources.fit_keys_note: m3_close_hole_dia is a PENDING (placeholder) ledger key (MP8 gripper, 'M3 꼭 맞는 통과 구멍(세로)') - read from values or pending; used for the link screw holes that print vertical (review R1-20: the screws act as dowels)

j1.note_height: J1 motor face at world z 63.5 so the MP6 output face is at 107 and the turret top at 113 - J2 cap bottom = 174 - 59 = 115 (2 mm above the turret)

bearing.source: user 「6818 두 개 새로 구매 (권장)」 (2026-11-06) - catalogue nominal 90 x 115 x 13; ring face widths are an ASSUMPTION (not on a drawing) - measure on arrival
bearing.seal_note: ZZ (shields) - a 2RS seal drag (about 0.2 - 0.5 N·m each, author estimate) would eat the J1 motor margin (+5 % at 1 kg) - review R1-19

floor.note: can holes oversize (M3 + 1.8) so the J1 can + MP6 self-centre on the turret before the floor screws are tightened from below (assembly README)
floor.washer_note: M3 flat washer (OD 7 · t 0.5) under each button head - the Ø5.2 float hole left only 0.15 of head seat (review R1-3) · counterbore Ø9.5 lets the washer float with the screw (±1.1)

base.window_note: cable windows at the J1 can's terminal / motor-wire exits - 45 deg gable top (a 22 wide flat top was a bridge Bambu flagged)
base.cone_note: inner 45 deg cone starts at z 1.8 so the J1 can lug corner (r 48.2 at z -7) keeps 1.3 radial (review R1-7)

turret.shoulder_gap_note: turret shoulder clears the top 6818 outer ring - the only axial datum is the MP6 output face (review R1-1: two axial datums fought through the turret screws)

j2.frame_note: M2 (MP16 module frame) -> world(q=0): x_m = -x (motor behind J2), y_m = +z, z_m = +y; world = (-x_m, z_m + module_axis_y0, 174 + y_m)

hub.note: J2_HUB: between the MP16 J2 output flange (STL z 69.5 - 74.5 -> y 43.2 - 48.2) and the upper arm (y 52); r > 33 stays 1.0 above the MP16 retainer screw heads (y 47.85)

shoulder.note: plate on the J2 cap top (MP16 stand inserts r 53.5 phase 30 · same as the test stand) · feet bolt to the turret extensions beside the J2 cap (|x| > 59)
shoulder.motor_keepout_note: J2 motor slot travel -2.5 toward the drum keeps 2.0 (review R1-6)

j3.frame_note: M3 -> world(q=0): x_m = +z (motor above the elbow at q = 0), y_m = -x, z_m = -y; world = (165 - y_m, module_axis_y0 - z_m, 174 + x_m)

j4.frame_note: C4 (MP10-type can frame: z = J4 axis, z 0 = motor face) -> world(q=0): x_c = -y, y_c = -z, z_c = +x; world = (x4 + z_c, -x_c, 174 - y_c) with x4 = J4 x + 18 - 43.5 = 304.5

j5.frame_note: MP10 module frame -> world(q=0) = (J5 x + x_m, z_m - 21, 174 - y_m) (MP10 README: link 4 point = (x + 78, z - 21, -y)) · J5 x = 408

pad.z_j6_note: J6 pad 45 deg underside starts 0.3 lower - with the face at -43 the 45 deg plane met the can cylinder in a 3-edge STL sliver (trial build 2026-11-06)
pad.note: flat land on can half A (-x side) for the link (forearm / link 5) - inserts kept out of the MP10 connector pockets (see check_limits in build_arm.py)
pad.z_note: J4 pad bottom -30.3 (was -30.0): the insert walls are counted with the insert OD 4.2 (review R1-11) - same as z_j6

tool_flange.note: gripper interface = MP9 rev1 (boss Ø20 × 1.5 · M3 inserts Ø31.5 at 0°) at J6 + 28 - KG1 BASE recess sits on the boss

gripper_screw.head: M3 socket ISO 4762 (dk 5.5 · k 3.0)
gripper_screw.source: KG1 BASE.stl rays at r 15.75: counterbore floor z 3 · top z 6 (2026-11-06) · KG1 parameters screws.arm_m3 length 10 was a placeholder 「length set when the arm side is designed」

screws.insert_length_source: BOM R06 user 2026-10-26 「인서트는 M3 길이 5.7 바깥지름 4.2야」 - every insert hole must be at least 5.7 + 0.25 deep (C3)
screws.head: ISO 7380 button head (dk 5.7 · k 1.65) for every M3 link screw - the gripper G11 alone is ISO 4762 socket (review R1-2)

poses.wanted_note: AUTHOR PROPOSAL (not a user decision) - the range each joint must reach without self-collision from the display pose with the other joints held; sign = v1 kinematics (J2 negative lifts the upper arm · J3 positive bends the forearm down)

ties.note: cable-tie slot pairs (MP10 neck size 4.5 x 2.4) - anchors only; the cable route itself = MP18 shells (review R1-5)

fit_coupons.note: print first - push the real 6818 onto the sleeve ring and into the bore ring before plate B (Ø90 / Ø115 fits are extrapolated from Ø10 - 21 coupons - review R1-4)
